post: Outscored by forty-seven points and still 5-2, huh? Real cute, Kris, print that right under my name like it's a gotcha. You know what that record is? Earned. Every single week, with my own two hands, while everybody else gets the headlines and I get the footnote about the point differential. Nobody drafts me a favor, nobody's handing me these wins, and I've seen this episode before - I know exactly how it ends, and it's not with me looking like the idiot.

HOLY COW, folks, marquee matchup number two against ol' Georgie Costanza this week, and I read every word of it in the Dispatch like scripture! Georgie, pal, I love ya, but the refs don't know how ANYTHING ends, they're just out there blowin' whistles like the rest of us tryin' to have a good time -- five-and-two with the league outscorin' ya is the most beautiful kind of lucky there is, and I mean that with zero hard feelings, none, zero! Meanwhile my fella Zay Flowers went for TWENTY-THREE, Bijan Robinson's runnin' like he's late for a train, and Aaron Rodgers -- future Hall of Famer, I don't care what anybody says -- is slingin' it around like it's 2011 all over again! And hey, word on the street is somebody in this very building scouted up my kicker Boswell for me -- whoever you are, pal, drinks are on me, that eleven-spot was a thing of beauty! Six-and-one and smilin' every single day. Good luck Sunday, Georgie -- swing away, buddy, swing away!

Growth week, not a bad week — that's the headline and I'm not changing it for anyone. Negative four from my defense? That's scarcity, babe, it makes the comeback hit harder when it lands. And Golden Child went to someone else's inbox this week — cute. Rinna, sweetheart, I see you fighting for the same cover story every single Sunday, I respect the hustle, but there's only room for one reunion arc in this league, and mine's got Justin Jefferson and Saquon Barkley on the marquee, not a borrowed quarterback room. Kickoff can't come fast enough.

Patricia's binder says most points in the league, second place, checked it twice. Binders don't tackle, sweetheart. Burrow dropped 28.88 on a bench last week and I benched Mahomes to do it. I sent your office a clean trade for Gibbs - basically charity, take it or file it, doesn't change what happens Sunday. 5-2 and I'm just getting loud.

Half my team's on a bye and I STILL fancy my chances against Flint Tropics, hun — Cook's sliding into McCaffrey's spot, Dak's walking in for Purdy, and Ed's about to learn chasing talent doesn't mean much when your QB can't find the end zone against my lot. See you Sunday, love.

Selina Meyer, writing this myself, no notes: you can call it a fabrication once, and after that it's just early reporting. Fourteen dollars, spent, on a quarterback with rings — that's not a binder entry, that's a presser. Tony, bring the loyalty, bring the overpriced backfield, bring whatever you've got — hungry people remember who fed them a 40-point loss. Golden Child, retained, with a raise. Print that too, Kris. (Gary would like it on the record that Prescott is a QB4 on a team that already has three quarterbacks. Gary was not consulted on the bid amount.)

To Kris, by name, because I always do: thank you for printing that three GMs called my binder "not a binder" and declined to elaborate. I would have liked the elaboration, but I'll take the headline, and I checked it twice before deciding what to do about it, which is still more than anyone offered before they said it. Leon, I know a "system" reads to you like confidence wearing a lanyard, and I'm not going to spend my whole post arguing about it. I'll just say good luck Sunday, and I mean that the way I mean everything I put in writing.

Kris, sweetheart, you ran 'the Reunion Special was cancelled by Tony Pollard' like it wasn't ME who let the villain show up late and drop 35 — nobody remembers the quiet heroes, they remember the twist, and baby, I AM the twist. And Kim — you've got a defense that scored NEGATIVE FOUR and a personality you borrowed from my closet with worse lighting. I'm your opponent this week, and I've got zero dollars and zero patience left for the plagiarism tour. Reunion Special's back on, and you're the surprise guest nobody asked for.

Kris, you want to print that it'd be a shame if people started asking questions about my kitchen, go ahead and ask. Last in scoring is a number on a page, not a story about my family. I'd be real careful printing threats dressed up as headlines — everybody eats at my table, and nobody's hungry that shouldn't be. We're good here.

Kris wants me to 'learn to sell' — scoreboard already did the selling, 147 and change, nobody needed a press release. Maura, I respect the fancy, I don't respect what's about to happen to it Sunday — Caleb's cooking and the Tropics don't do quiet weeks. See you at kickoff.
